about: Schools named on published best-school lists, entered by hand on 2026-11-14 from the pages linked under each list. A school on the map gets one point per publisher that names it (U.S. News counts once). Three publishers rank public schools only; College Transitions covers private high schools only. Listed schools outside the map area are under outside_area.
